input.summary: Add an express Company convenience termination on 90 days' notice, limit HDI's no-cause termination to the end of the then-current term, and cap the Termination Payment at three months of the amounts payable to HDI under Section 3.1.
input.comment: [Playbook] We added an express right for the Company to exit for convenience on ninety (90) days' notice and confined HDI's no-cause termination to the end of the then-current term. We also capped the Termination Payment at the amounts payable to HDI under Section 3.1 for the three months before the Termination Date, so the exit cost is ascertainable. This is our fallback position on termination for convenience.

ops.oldText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two, provided that the Termination Payment shall not exceed the amounts payable to HDI under Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date.

ops.oldText: 4.1 Term; Termination. This Agreement shall be effective as of that date (the "Effective Date") the Site becomes fully operational as set forth in writing and executed by both Parties and shall continue for a period of one (1) year from the Effective Date. This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date").
ops.newText: 4.1 Term; Termination. This Agreement shall be effective as of that date (the "Effective Date") the Site becomes fully operational as set forth in writing and executed by both Parties and shall continue for a period of one (1) year from the Effective Date. This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other, provided that termination by HDI shall be effective only at the end of the then-current term. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date"). The Company may also terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon ninety (90) days written notice to HDI specifying the Termination Date.
